<h2>Extract an Optional Spatial MEM Basis Component</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Extracts one explicit component from a reusable spatial MEM basis while
preserving 'NULL' when the basis is disabled.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>extract_spatial_mev_basis_component(list_spatial_mev_basis, component_name)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="list_spatial_mev_basis">list_spatial_mev_basis</code></td>
<td>
<p>Reusable spatial MEM basis list or 'NULL'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="component_name">component_name</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar naming the component to extract.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Selected component or 'NULL'.
</p>

</main>
